name: Dreamsect // Rebel Cycle // Episode 1: Days of Innocence
source:
This is a world inhabited those called "Paranormals" and "Casuals," who have endured a millennia-long hostility. After an ally to the Casual Holy Longinii Empire, the Vampire Kingdom of Oltvenia,  is invaded by an unknown force, the threat of war hangs heavy  in the air, and the future of the world falls to the hands of those who seek the "truth" and "justice."

[From [url=https://aquasoft.itch.io/days-of-innocence-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
